description: This file defines the GrainTypeSharedContext class, which manages shared functionality and state for all instances of a specific grain type within the Orleans runtime. It handles component management, configuration options, grain directory resolution, and lifecycle events related to grain activation and deactivation.

classes.name: GrainTypeSharedContext
classes.description: Manages shared context and operations for all grain instances of a specific type, including component registration, configuration, and lifecycle event handling.

methods.name: GetComponent
methods.description: Retrieves a registered component or service related to the grain type, such as placement strategy or logger.

methods.name: SetComponent
methods.description: Registers or unregisters a component instance for the grain type, allowing dependency injection.

methods.name: OnCreateActivation
methods.description: Invoked when a new grain activation is created; increments grain count metrics.

methods.name: OnDestroyActivation
methods.description: Invoked when a grain activation is destroyed; decrements grain count metrics.
